sources.authority: Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR) / Department of Health Research, Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, Government of India
sources.title: Standard Treatment Workflow (STW) for Ante-Natal Management of Normal Pregnancy
sources.notes: Current high-priority India baseline for normal ANC discovered during the 2026-08-12 evidence pass. Rule extraction must be reconciled with relevant NHM/MoHFW programme guidance before promotion.

sources.title: Dietary Guidelines for Indians 2024
sources.notes: Primary India nutrition guideline. Nutrient values and pregnancy/lactation recommendations require rule-level extraction and clinical review before use.

sources.authority: National Health Mission, Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, Government of India
sources.title: Anaemia Mukt Bharat Abhiyaan Operational Guidelines 2026
sources.notes: NHM currently lists a 2026 operational guideline. Must be reconciled with ICMR ANC STW and clinician review before any dose/timing rule is enabled.

sources.authority: National Health Mission, Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, Government of India
sources.title: National Guidelines for Diagnosis & Management of Gestational Diabetes Mellitus
sources.notes: Older national document. Do not promote rules until reconciled with newer ICMR workflows and current specialist guidance.

sources.title: Standard Treatment Workflows (STWs) — official index
sources.notes: Use as the canonical discovery index for current ICMR STWs; individual documents require separate source records and review.

sources.authority: National Health Mission, Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, Government of India
sources.title: Maternal Health Guidelines — official NHM index
sources.notes: Current NHM index exposes maternal-health guidance including postnatal care, high-risk pregnancy, PMSMA, MCP card and safe motherhood materials. Individual documents require separate source records.

sources.authority: Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, Government of India
sources.title: Pradhan Mantri Surakshit Matritva Abhiyan (PMSMA)
sources.notes: Useful for India-specific ANC service pathways and high-risk pregnancy programme context. Clinical thresholds must come from reviewed clinical guidance, not programme marketing copy.

sources.authority: Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, Government of India
sources.title: U-WIN / Universal Immunization Programme
sources.notes: Operational source for vaccination registration/programme information. Vaccine recommendations and contraindications require the current national immunization schedule/guideline and clinician review.

sources.authority: Food Safety and Standards Authority of India
sources.title: Eat Right India materials
sources.notes: Use for food-safety/hygiene support. Do not infer pregnancy-specific prohibitions or disease-specific diets from generic material.

sources.authority: National Health Mission, Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, Government of India
sources.title: MAA — Mothers' Absolute Affection operational guidance
sources.notes: India-specific breastfeeding programme source. Detailed rule extraction remains pending.
